text:
oliver-rep: Quick ask — Nimbus AI (reseller pilot via Crescendo Partners) is pushing for a custom onboarding package. Sales wants a 30% credit on month 1 + prorated commit for a 6-month term, and a temporary SLA bump to 99.9% for the first 90 days. Need finance sign-off before we present formal terms.

maria-lloyd: can you paste the numbers? need ARR impact + margin delta. also, what's the rationale for SLA change?

oliver-rep: rationale = they have a production cutover scheduled and will route initial traffic through us; they're sensitive to latency in early weeks. Usage estimate = ~200M tokens month1 (mostly generation). List price = $0.20 / 1k tokens. Proposed commercial structure: 6-month minimum, month1 = 30% credit applied to invoice, months 2-6 at list.

oliver-rep: quick calc:
```
price_per_1k = $0.20
expected_tokens = 200,000,000
expected_k = 200,000
gross_month_rev = expected_k * 0.20 = $40,000
30% credit = $12,000
```

ben_finance: thanks. 30% on month1 = $12k hit gross. what's expected net margin after credits? and do we cap the credit or tie to milestones? policy note: discounts >25% usually need VP sign-off. tagging that here.

katie-cs: Sales says risk of losing deal if we don't move fast. They proposed capping the credit at $12k and only issuing it as a service credit (not cash) after they hit 50% of expected usage in month1. Also willing to put the 6-month commitment in writing.

maria-lloyd: margin check — if we issue $12k credit and month1 revenue nets to $28k, with COGS estimate ~30% for this workload, margin impact is acceptable short-term. but we need a cap and metric tie.

dealbot: Policy check: discount >25% requires VP Finance approval. Recommend structure: (1) issue credit as a one-time invoice credit, (2) cap at $12k, (3) condition credit on hitting 100M tokens in month1, (4) record as deferred revenue adjustment for GAAP. Flagging @ben_finance and @maria-lloyd.

ben_finance: I can approve conditionally: one-time 30% credit up to $12k, credit applied only if Nimbus reports >=100M tokens in billing month1 (we will validate via logs), legal to review SLA addendum wording, and sales to accept that this is a non-recurring onboarding concession. Finance-ops: please confirm invoicing flow (service credit vs negative invoice).

maria-lloyd: agree. require cap and usage verification. also want a short clause that credit is forfeited if they churn within 90 days.

katie-cs: noted — sales will include the churn clause and commitment language. They want to get this into a signed MSA addendum by Friday.

ben_finance: okay — I will escalate to VP of Finance for final sign-off (policy) but this is a + from me with the conditions listed.

oliver-rep: great. next steps: I'll update sales pitch, get the SLA wording to Legal, and share the proposed MSA addendum. Will tag finance-ops once draft is ready so they can prepare the credit accounting treatment. Thanks all :thumbsup:

dealbot: Recording resolution: conditional approval pending VP sign-off and legal SLA addendum. I will create a tracking ticket in #deal-desk with the conditions.
